messages:
Alex M: FYI — customer acme-inc hitting indexing failures on embeddings ingest, started ~09:12 PST. API returns a 400/422 and indexer logs show 'dimension mismatch'.
Priya K: Can you paste the error blob + model param they used?
Alex M: They call POST /v1/embeddings with model=redwood-embed-large, batch of 200; embedding payload length in response is 3072. Their vector DB index was created with "dims=1536".
Dan R: Did they recently change model or did we roll any embed models in us-west-2?
Alex M: We rolled redwood-embed-large v2 -> v3 last night at ~02:00Z in us-west-2 (release notes said larger dim). Customer claims nothing changed on their side.
Sasha L: Quick checklist: 1) confirm embedding response length from our API 2) confirm index schema dims 3) check client/SDK versions 4) see if indexer should validate dims before bulk insert.
Alex M: Confirmed via curl — our response: 
```
{"object":"embedding","data":[{"embedding":[0.003, -0.12, ... ],"index":0}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":8}}
```
Length = 3072.
Indexer log: `ERROR Indexer: dimension mismatch expected=1536 actual=3072 id=doc_12345 batch=7`.
Priya K: Ok. Customer wants remediation options. Short list we can offer: 1) use redwood-embed-small (1536) and re-ingest, 2) recreate index to accept 3072, or 3) down-project embeddings (PCA/average) and backfill.
Alex M: They tried redwood-embed-small for a small sample; inserts succeeded but their app assumes 1536 feature vector shape in downstream ranking code — lots of dependencies. They want us to help with a backfill and a safer migration plan.
Dan R: From infra side, we should detect this earlier: when indexer receives the first batch, validate dims vs index schema and fail fast with a descriptive message (include expected/actual and model name). Also include `embedding_dim` in our /v1/embeddings response header/body to make debugging easier.
Sasha L: Agreed. Proposed short-term mitigation: add pre-ingest validation and a clear 409 response from indexer that contains: `expected_dim`, `got_dim`, `model`, `sample_id`. Long-term: surface embedding dim in console and SDK at generation time.
ops-bot: deploy event: rolling upgrade redwood-embed-service v3 -> v3.1 triggered by deploy-bot at 2026-03-15T02:00:12Z
deploy-bot: canary finished in us-west-2, 10% traffic.
Alex M: Customer asked for repro steps we can share with their engineers. Here's a minimal curl repro they can run locally to confirm mismatch: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large","input":["test document"]}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```
Expect: 3072.
And their indexer failing log sample: 
```
2026-03-15T09:12:34Z ERROR indexer InsertBatch failed id=doc_12345 err="dimension mismatch: expected=1536 got=3072" namespace=acme_prod shard=12
```
Priya K: Customer is on reserved monthly contract; mark this P1 for support response SLA. They want either: rollback the embed model in their region to the old dim, or coordinated backfill. Can eng-ml rollback v3 -> v2 for us-west-2 only?
Dan R: Rollback is possible but risky because v3 may have bugfixes. Alternative: open a patch release of the API that advertises `embedding_dim` and rejects mismatched downstream index writes with a clear 409 + remediation link. Also we can offer to run a one-off backfill job for the customer if they sign the support change order.
Sasha L: I've created internal ticket SUP-2026-487 and scheduled a customer call at 16:00 PST. I'll collect: full batch payload, index schema JSON, and list of affected doc ids.
Alex M: Customer also called out throughput issues during retries — their indexer tried exponential backoff and then big batches causing repeated mismatches and partial writes. Repro steps we gave them: reduce ingest batch_size to 1-10 for failure windows, and set client to verify shape before sending.
Priya K: For immediate triage, provide this mitigation checklist to customer: 
- set model=redwood-embed-small for new writes (temp)
- set client-side validation: `if len(e) != index_dims: halt and alert`
- if acceptable, create a new index with dims=3072 and run backfill (we can provide estimate)
- avoid large batch retries until schema validated

Dan R: Action items for us: 
- eng-ml: add embedding_dim in API response + update docs (high)
- eng-platform: add pre-ingest validation in indexer and better error message (high)
- support: prepare migration/backfill offer and cost estimate (high)
- devex: add migration example script (pca/downproject) to docs (medium)

Sasha L: I'll attach logs and the sample curl to the support ticket. Also tagging eng-ml @Dan R and eng-platform @Priya K for visibility.
Alex M: Thanks team — keeping the customer in the loop. Will post update after the 16:00 call. :thumbsup:
